+def build_pairs(users, labels, seed):

+    cuts = np.flatnonzero(sorted_users[1:] != sorted_users[:-1]) + 1
+    starts = np.concatenate(([0], cuts))
+    ends = np.concatenate((cuts, [len(order)]))
+    rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)
+    pos_parts, neg_parts = [], []
+    for start, end in zip(starts, ends):
+        group = order[start:end]
+        positive = group[labels[group]]
+        negative = group[~labels[group]]
+        if len(positive) and len(negative):
+            chosen = negative[rng.randint(0, len(negative), size=len(positive))]
+            pos_parts.append(positive.astype(np.int64, copy=False))
+            neg_parts.append(chosen.astype(np.int64, copy=False))

method_selection.why: The tuned package improved 0.6018 to 0.6037, only +0.0019 and below epsilon, indicating that remaining single-run signal is near seed noise. A 5-seed per-user rank ensemble is the only available card outside the excluded overfit/underfit families and has measured-alive evidence on Pure. Honest expected gain is about +0.0004 to +0.001, so it is a variance-reduction move rather than an epsilon-clearing gain.

rejected.reason: It fits the temporal split but is marked running-elsewhere and is already included in the accepted package.
It intersects the excluded overfit/underfit families and would repeat the package search used by node_001.
Although untried, it treats the explicitly excluded overfit family.

expected_delta_basis: The selected seed-ensemble card reports measured-alive Pure primary around 0.6058 and an expected +0.0004 to +0.001 from five-member variance cancellation, consistent with Lakshminarayanan et al. (2017).
